tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
One of your colleagues has just received a mandatory invitation to attend a computer workshop next Friday. For some reasons, he is unsure whether he needs to go.
Write an email to your colleague. In your email, tell him
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: The reasons why the new workshop is required.
To confirm his attendance or absence.
How to prepare for the session.
tasks.to: One of your colleagues Subject: Clarifying next Friday’s computer workshop
tasks.subject: Clarifying next Friday’s computer workshop
tasks.sample:
Dear Sammy,
I am writing to clarify why your attendance at next Friday’s computer workshop is compulsory and to request your prompt confirmation.

The session will train staff on the critical security patch released on 1 December. This update was not covered in the workshop you completed three months ago and must be applied to all corporate devices before year-end.

Please reply to this e-mail no later than Wednesday, 14 December, indicating either:
• “Confirmed – will attend” or
• “Unable to attend – on business travel.”
Anyone unable to attend will be scheduled for the January makeup session.

• Bring your fully charged company laptop with the latest office suite already installed.
• Arrive at Training Room 3B by 09:15 for a 09:30 start; materials and network credentials will be distributed on site.

Thank you for your cooperation.
Best regards,
Kelly Well
Head of Personnel
tasks.title: Write an Email
